title: Merge a near-duplicate and refine another rule in the same game
shows: Two-object task, retry 1 wins. The Builder writes a rule that is a near-duplicate of rule_5 and it is merged into it (counted as agreement). A new Success Process is written, and the contrastive refiner rewrites rule_10 from its won and lost games.
why_interesting: Shows merge + refine together, which are the MACLA-style rule management operations (E only; E-minus cannot do either).

rules_shown_in_first_attempt.rule: When objects must be retrieved and placed, search all possible locations systematically before attempting to complete the task.
rules_shown_in_first_attempt.example: The agent failed because it never searched for the two cellphones, only opened drawers and observed existing items.
rules_shown_in_first_attempt.validation: This game confirmed the rule: the agent failed because it never located or picked up the two cellphones, only opening drawers and observing existing items without searching for the target objects.

rules_shown_in_first_attempt.rule: When the goal requires cooling an object, locate and take the object from a surface before attempting to open any cabinets.

rules_shown_in_first_attempt.validation: This game confirmed the rule: the agent failed because it never found or cooled a plate, instead spending all time opening cabinets and drawers without checking countertops.

retries.reflection: I only found and moved one keychain (keychain 3) from desk 1 to drawer 1, but the goal requires two keychains. I should have examined the desk more thoroughly or checked other locations for a second keychain before giving up, as the desk initially showed multiple items that might have included another keychain or I missed it during my initial scan.

operations.example: Search desk 1 and sidetable 1, take keychains, open drawer 1, move keychains to drawer 1.
operations.rule: When two keychains must be placed in a drawer: search desk and sidetable first, take keychains from surfaces, open the target drawer if closed, move each keychain to the drawer.
When an object must be placed in a container and multiple objects are needed, search the room for all objects first before opening the container.
